title: Anybody else enter the Mall World intentionally?
content: I've had mall world dreams since I was a kid, always felt like I was being chased in them. I turned around one day, and found that there was nothing there. Since then, I've taken to exploring them deliberately. I used to only wind up there accidentally, before I discovered the Mall World phenomena online I called it "The place between dreams" because it's always felt close to waking up despite never being able to wake up deliberately from it, and doors can lead into deeper dreams. For me, it's an infinite number of doors with no coherent reason why one "room" is connected to another. But I found that, in lucid dreams, I can "will" a door into opening into the Mall World so long as I can't see the other side of it (e.g. glass doors don't work). I feel like there's something within these dreams that is important but I'm not sure what I'm looking for. Also, I tend to start to wake up unintentionally when too lucid now, to try to maintain the dream, I focus on my hand and force detail into it to ground. Anyone else have similar tricks?
